background.description: The color around the window, as #rrggbb; none, or another text, for the theme's background, darker.

transparent-background.description: No background around the window: the image is clear there.

padding.description: The room around the window, in points.

rounded-corners.description: The window's corners rounded, or square.

window-controls.description: The window's three buttons in its bar.

title.description: The pane's title in the window's bar.

target.description: The image of the window with what is around it, or of the window alone.

action.description: What the shutter does: copies the image, saves it through the save panel, or both.

scale.description: The pixels of a point of the image; none for the display's.
